name: Hail Hydra
summary: Hidden-role team combat where S.H.I.E.L.D. tries to defeat villains while secret HYDRA agents sabotage attacks on New York City.
rules_text: Players get a secret loyalty disc: S.H.I.E.L.D. or HYDRA. Number of HYDRA is public. HYDRA open eyes together to learn each other. Five villains are stacked with Red Skull last. NYC starts at 27 health. Each villain has health and attack. A Mission is one villain, made of Offensives. Each Offensive: pass first-player token left; new first player discards hand and draws 6, others draw 1. In clockwise order each hero plays 1-3 attack cards face-down. Cards are blue +1 to +4 and red -2 to -5. All played cards are shuffled and revealed, summed. Positive sum damages villain after subtracting defense. Negative or zero fails. If villain survives, it damages NYC and triggers its power. Repeat Offensive until villain dead or NYC at 0. When villain dead, vote to knock out suspected HYDRA. If NYC reaches 0 HYDRA wins; if all villains defeated S.H.I.E.L.D. wins.
rating_reason: Social deduction hidden roles, turn-based discussion and voting.
